name: @teactjs/mongodb
description: MongoDB storage driver, session store and plugin for Teact

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/core --external @teactjs/storage --external @teactjs/plugin-sdk --external mongodb && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/fix-dts.ts
